evidence.label: Definition [Saturation]: kappa-saturation over parameter sets of size < kappa, finite tuples

components.note: Prime (elementary embedding into every model), atomic (every finite tuple satisfies an atom), homogeneous (equal-type finite tuples moved by an automorphism) and saturated (Vaught one-coordinate extension; modern kappa-saturation over parameter sets of size < kappa; aleph_0 = finite parameters) are defined; tuple, parameter and cardinal scopes are separated explicitly, including the countable-parameter obstruction. Judged against the subgoal text, which is source-neutral; the source-specific presentation is judged under N-a-003-C01.

Countable prime <-> atomic in both directions (prime -> atomic by omitting a nonprincipal type) and prime existence <-> atomistic <-> density of isolated types, with the step-by-step atomic embedding construction, all proved in the annex. Judged against the subgoal text, which is source-neutral; the source-specific presentation is judged under N-a-003-C01.
